parsed.explanation: After Liu’s first claim and Xiang’s response, it is Liu’s turn on M'', so induction gives Xiang the second-player guarantee even(M''), not odd(M''). The subsequent calculations explicitly use the incorrect odd(M'') quantity, so this is not merely a role-label typo. No other passage proves Xiang’s matching upper guarantee for the claiming phase. The lemma can be repaired by replacing that half of the induction with the even(M'') guarantee and supplying the corresponding parity inequalities.
